_about: Sample emails for the Gmail structured-extraction take-home. Fully self-contained — no access to our stack needed. 'flight-ref' is worked out for you (shows the target shape). 'promo-decoy' is worked too (must come back category 'none'). The five categories in buildThese are yours to extract. All emails are synthetic — no real user data.
